# Terra Men's Co.
A premium grooming brand focusing on scientifically formulated, botanical skincare and beard care products for men.

## About
Terra Men's Co. ("Because Men Deserve Better") provides luxury grooming fundamentals including the Terra Face Wash and Terra Beard Oil. We use cold-pressed botanicals, biocompatible cleansing, and UV apothecary glass. Zero synthetic compromise.

## Core Principles
1. Biocompatible Cleansing
2. First Cold-Pressed Oils
3. UV Apothecary Glass
4. Zero Synthetic Compromise (No parabens, phthalates, SLS, synthetic fragrances)
